description: RAVEN_NEARBY_LINK_V1 §2. K_root is the R2 pairwise root of RAVEN_LAN_BEACON_V1 §2.2 (RAVEN_PRIVATE_RENDEZVOUS_V1 §5.3a item 2): Z = X25519 of one identity's Ed25519 secret scalar with the Montgomery form of the other identity key, K_root = HKDF-SHA256(salt 'rvn1/r2-pair/v1', ikm Z, info 'root' || lo || hi, 32 bytes) with lo and hi the two Ed25519 keys sorted bytewise; the same bytes as lan_beacon/lbcn_pair_keys_001.json for the same pair. K_ble = HKDF-Expand-SHA256(PRK K_root, info 'medium' || 0x01, 32 bytes). K_tok = HKDF-Expand-SHA256(PRK K_ble, info 'RNB1-token', 32 bytes) and K_knock = HKDF-Expand-SHA256(PRK K_ble, info 'RNB1-knock', 32 bytes). Both sides of a pair compute the same keys. These keys only make beacon tokens and knock tags: never a message, session, route, mailbox or ACK key
name: RNB1 pair keys: the R2 pairwise root, its Bluetooth LE medium key, K_tok and K_knock
